sections.heading: Core idea — 5 Paths
sections.subtitle: 5 Paths
sections.contentMarkdown:
- Business: Direction, decision, and operation.
- Creator: Content and trust.
- Analyst: Numbers and decisions.
- Automator: Repetitive tasks.
- Builder (optional): Custom tools when needed.

sections.heading: Quiz
sections.subtitle: Select the best option based on the above section.
sections.contentMarkdown:
Builder — Immediately builds an application.
Automator — Automates repetitive follow-ups.
Creator — Just content.
Explanation: The correct answer is Automator, as it focuses on automating repetitive tasks.
